answer: Requester-side job bonds stop sybil farms from inventing fake work. A job enters the river only after its requester locks 100 POA, released when the work is done and paid. Each epoch, falcon auditors sample 10 percent of posted jobs and confirm with the worker that the task was real. A fake posting burns the 100 POA lock and bans the requester for 8 epochs. Every lock and audit is written to a public juniper ledger, so a farm posting 40 fake jobs loses 4,000 POA in one sweep.
